Microsoft.title: Windows Is Phasing Out Old-Generation Snapdragon Laptops: Why This "Rushed" Transition Could Be a Game-Changer for Users
Microsoft.titleEn: Windows Is Phasing Out Old-Generation Snapdragon Laptops: Why This "Rushed" Transition Could Be a Game-Changer for Users
Microsoft.summary:
Microsoft phased out a large number of old x86 platforms 16 years ago in 2024, but now the Snapdragon 850, which was born just over 8 years ago, is also about to be "banned".
Intel first introduced the SSE4.2 instruction set on the first-generation Core i series launched in 2008, the second-generation Core i series in 2011 brought the AVX instruction set, and in 2013, the fourth-generation Core i series introduced AVX2.
It announced that the next major version of the Windows 11 system after 26H2 will no longer support devices based on the Qualcomm Snapdragon 850 processor.

Microsoft.title: Microsoft’s new AI chip makes it less reliant on Nvidia’s GPUs

Microsoft.titleKo: Microsoft의 새로운 AI 칩으로 Nvidia의 GPU에 대한 의존도가 낮아졌음
Microsoft.summary:
“We expect Maia 300 to deliver 40 percent more tokens per megawatt compared to leading GPU-based systems,” says Scott Guthrie , executive vice president of Microsoft’s cloud group.
Maia 300 is also a key part of Microsoft’s own AI model work, and could help the company achieve its goal of catching up with Google DeepMind, OpenAI, and Anthropic.
“And in a full 96-accelerator configuration, it delivers up to 7x the rack-scale token throughput of Maia 200.”

Microsoft.title: Deep dive into Azure Maia 300 architecture | Microsoft Azure Blog
Microsoft.titleEn: Deep dive into Azure Maia 300 architecture | Microsoft Azure Blog

Microsoft.summary:
Maia 300 brings 2.5 times the memory bandwidth, 33% more capacity, and approximately 2 times the HBM bandwidth per watt compared with Maia 200 Maia 300 makes the network a native extension of its software-defined dataflow architecture.
Second, new narrow-precision formats with hardware-accelerated data type conversion reduce the bytes moved for each token.
Building on the foundational energy efficiency of the Maia SoC architecture, the Maia 300 rack co-designs server layout and density, network topology and switching, power and cooling design, and advanced telemetry to deliver up to 2.5x more performance per watt compared to Maia 200. 96 accelerators within 167 kW Maia 300 integrates 96 accelerators across 24 four-accelerator trays within a 167-kW rack, doubling the accelerator density of Maia 200.

NVIDIA.title: From Earth to Orbit, France’s Ecosystem Delivers Agentic Computing at Scale With NVIDIA
NVIDIA.titleEn: From Earth to Orbit, France’s Ecosystem Delivers Agentic Computing at Scale With NVIDIA
NVIDIA.titleKo: 지구에서 궤도까지, 프랑스의 생태계는 NVIDIA를 통해 대규모 에이전트 컴퓨팅을 제공함
NVIDIA.summary:
In Côte-d’Or, ThinkDeep and Akila built a digital-twin agent — powered by NVIDIA Cosmos open world models, Nemotron and Omniverse libraries — managing nearly 5,800 kilometers of roads and buildings, cutting total operating costs by 10% and targeting 30% as deployment progresses.
Altair-1, the first satellite in a $1 billion, 50-satellite constellation with on-board autonomous capabilities, launched this month and has successfully reached orbit.
Fondation Inria , with NVIDIA’s support, is launching a working group on open source advanced modeling and tool adoption, with findings to come in the spring of next year.
summaryLinesEn: In Côte-d’Or, ThinkDeep and Akila built a digital-twin agent — powered by NVIDIA Cosmos open world models, Nemotron and Omniverse libraries — managing nearly 5,800 kilometers of roads and buildings, cutting total operating costs by 10% and targeting 30% as deployment progresses.
Altair-1, the first satellite in a $1 billion, 50-satellite constellation with on-board autonomous capabilities, launched this month and has successfully reached orbit.
Fondation Inria , with NVIDIA’s support, is launching a working group on open source advanced modeling and tool adoption, with findings to come in the spring of next year.
summaryLinesKo: 코트도르에서 ThinkDeep과 Akila는 NVIDIA Cosmos 오픈 월드 모델, Nemotron 및 Omniverse 라이브러리를 기반으로 하는 디지털 트윈 에이전트를 구축하여 거의 5,800km에 달하는 도로와 건물을 관리하고 총 운영 비용을 10% 절감했으며 배포가 진행됨에 따라 30%를 목표로 삼았음
탑재된 자율 기능을 갖춘 10억 달러 규모의 50개 위성 집합 중 첫 번째 위성인 Altair-1이 이번 달에 발사되어 성공적으로 궤도에 도달함
Fondation Inria는 NVIDIA의 지원을 받아 오픈 소스 고급 모델링 및 도구 채택에 관한 실무 그룹을 출범할 예정이며, 결과는 내년 봄에 나올 예정임

NVIDIA.title: All Systems Go: Global PC App Ecosystem Ready for NVIDIA RTX Spark
NVIDIA.titleEn: All Systems Go: Global PC App Ecosystem Ready for NVIDIA RTX Spark
NVIDIA.titleKo: All Systems Go: NVIDIA RTX Spark를 위한 글로벌 PC 앱 생태계 준비
NVIDIA.summary:
With up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute, RTX Spark delivers the full stack of NVIDIA RTX and CUDA technologies for creators, developers and gamers, while unlocking a new paradigm in personal computing via powerful local AI agents.
Local large language models (LLMs) surpassed the intelligence threshold to power agents, with models like Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next catching up to frontier cloud models released just a few months ago.
NVIDIA Switchyard, an open source model router library, enables agents to intelligently route queries between local and cloud LLMs, allowing the user to minimize cloud usage but still obtain similar results to just running on cloud.
summaryLinesEn: With up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute, RTX Spark delivers the full stack of NVIDIA RTX and CUDA technologies for creators, developers and gamers, while unlocking a new paradigm in personal computing via powerful local AI agents.
Local large language models (LLMs) surpassed the intelligence threshold to power agents, with models like Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next catching up to frontier cloud models released just a few months ago.

NVIDIA Switchyard, an open source model router library, enables agents to intelligently route queries between local and cloud LLMs, allowing the user to minimize cloud usage but still obtain similar results to just running on cloud.
summaryLinesKo: 최대 128GB의 통합 메모리와 1페타플롭의 AI 컴퓨팅을 갖춘 RTX Spark는 크리에이터, 개발자, 게이머를 위한 NVIDIA RTX 및 CUDA 기술의 전체 스택을 제공하는 동시에 강력한 로컬 AI 에이전트를 통해 개인 컴퓨팅의 새로운 패러다임을 열어줌
로컬 LLM(대형 언어 모델)은 Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next와 같은 모델이 불과 몇 달 전에 출시된 프론티어 클라우드 모델을 따라잡는 등 강력한 에이전트에 대한 인텔리전스 임계값을 넘어섰음
오픈 소스 모델 라우터 라이브러리인 NVIDIA Switchyard를 사용하면 에이전트가 로컬 LLM과 클라우드 LLM 간에 쿼리를 지능적으로 라우팅할 수 있으므로 사용자는 클라우드 사용량을 최소화하면서도 클라우드에서 실행하는 것과 유사한 결과를 얻을 수 있음

NVIDIA.titleKo: OCP 글로벌 서밋 · 생태계 채택 속에서 NVIDIA, 전 세계적으로 AI 공장 확장을 돕기 위해 Vera Rubin 아키텍처 공개
NVIDIA.summary:
At the Open Compute Project (OCP) Global Summit, taking place in the San Jose McEnery Convention Center, NVIDIA announced new partnerships and contributions aimed at creating a common foundation for next-generation AI infrastructure.
Visionbay introduced an 800V DC AI factory design for the Vera Rubin era.
The architecture supports rack deployments up to 250kW while simplifying serviceability, deployment and infrastructure reuse.

NVIDIA.titleEn: Microsoft’s new Nvidia PCs are cool for extreme power users - but I’ll wait for AI PC 3.0 - ZDNET
NVIDIA.titleKo: Microsoft의 새로운 Nvidia PC는 극한의 고급 사용자에게 적합하지만 AI PC 3.0을 기다릴 것입니다 - ZDNET
NVIDIA.summary:
Has Microsoft given up on its Copilot+ PC for the mass market?
Microsoft and Nvidia launched a new PC platform this week.
To earn that label, a Windows 11 PC had to have at least 16 GB of memory (double the minimum for a regular Windows 11 PC) and it needed a neural processing unit (NPU) capable of processing a minimum of 40 trillion operations per second — 40+ TOPS.
summaryLinesEn: Has Microsoft given up on its Copilot+ PC for the mass market?
Microsoft and Nvidia launched a new PC platform this week.

NVIDIA.title: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sink on OpenAI revenue report
NVIDIA.titleEn: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sink on OpenAI revenue report
NVIDIA.titleKo: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave 및 기타 AI 주식은 OpenAI 수익 보고서에서 하락
NVIDIA.summary:
OpenAI told investors that it hit roughly $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September, CNBC confirmed, lower than the the $68 billion figure widely reported late last month.
A person familiar with the matter said the $68 billion figure included gross revenue from OpenAI's partners, which helps investors make a more direct comparison with Anthropic.
Nvidia shares fell 3%, Oracle shares fell nearly 6% and CoreWeave shares slipped nearly 8% on Thursday.

Nvidia shares fell 3%, Oracle shares fell nearly 6% and CoreWeave shares slipped nearly 8% on Thursday.
summaryLinesKo: OpenAI는 투자자들에게 9월 말 연간 수익이 약 500억 달러에 이르렀다고 밝혔으며, 이는 지난달 말에 널리 보도된 680억 달러보다 낮은 수준이라고 CNBC는 확인함
이 문제에 정통한 한 관계자는 680억 달러 수치에는 OpenAI 파트너의 총 수익이 포함되어 있어 투자자들이 Anthropic과 보다 직접적으로 비교할 수 있다고 말함
Nvidia 주가는 목요일에 3% 하락했고 Oracle 주가는 거의 6% 하락했으며 CoreWeave 주가는 거의 8% 하락함

이 문제에 정통한 한 관계자는 680억 달러 수치에는 OpenAI 파트너의 총 수익이 포함되어 있어 투자자들이 Anthropic과 보다 직접적으로 비교할 수 있다고 말함
Nvidia 주가는 목요일에 3% 하락했고 Oracle 주가는 거의 6% 하락했으며 CoreWeave 주가는 거의 8% 하락함

NVIDIA.title: Nvidia's big bet on physical AI aims for safer robotaxis, humanoid robots
NVIDIA.titleEn: Nvidia's big bet on physical AI aims for safer robotaxis, humanoid robots
NVIDIA.titleKo: 물리적 AI에 대한 Nvidia의 큰 투자는 보다 안전한 로봇택시, 휴머노이드 로봇을 목표로 함
NVIDIA.summary:
Huang began highlighting physical AI as Nvidia’s second-most important growth category in 2025.
The expanded safety offering for robotics comes as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang described the physical AI business as already driving nearly $10 billion in annual revenue for the company during an appearance on the All-In Podcast in March 2026.
Nvidia’s Halos system launched in 2025 with hardware and software tools to help developers implement guardrails in self-driving cars and other autonomous vehicles.
summaryLinesEn: Huang began highlighting physical AI as Nvidia’s second-most important growth category in 2025.

Nvidia’s Halos system launched in 2025 with hardware and software tools to help developers implement guardrails in self-driving cars and other autonomous vehicles.
summaryLinesKo: Huang은 2025년 Nvidia의 두 번째로 중요한 성장 카테고리로 물리적 AI를 강조하기 시작함
엔비디아 CEO 젠슨 황(Jensen Huang)은 2026년 3월 올인 팟캐스트(All-In Podcast)에 출연하면서 물리적 AI 사업이 이미 회사의 연간 수익을 거의 100억 달러에 달한다고 설명하면서 로봇 공학을 위한 확장된 안전 제품이 출시됨
Nvidia의 Halos 시스템은 개발자가 자율주행차 및 기타 자율주행차에 가드레일을 구현하는 데 도움이 되는 하드웨어 및 소프트웨어 도구와 함께 2025년에 출시됨

NVIDIA.title: Rally Up: ‘Gears of War: E-Day’ Launches on GeForce NOW
NVIDIA.titleEn: Rally Up: ‘Gears of War: E-Day’ Launches on GeForce NOW
NVIDIA.titleKo: Rally Up: 'Gears of War: E-Day'가 GeForce NOW에서 출시됨
NVIDIA.summary:
Set 14 years before the original Gears of War , the prequel follows Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago as they confront the terrifying arrival of the Locust Horde on Emergence Day.
Better yet, the cost of the day pass can be applied toward a first monthly membership — making it easy to try GeForce RTX-powered cloud gaming with the latest releases, then level up for more.
There’s more in store this GFN Thursday, with the cloud serving up 10 games, including seven new releases.

summaryLinesKo: Gears of War 원작의 14년 전을 배경으로 하는 이 속편은 Marcus Fenix와 Dom Santiago가 Emergence Day에 로커스트 호드의 무서운 도착에 맞서는 이야기를 따름
더 좋은 점은 일일 패스 비용을 첫 번째 월간 멤버십에 적용할 수 있어 최신 릴리스로 GeForce RTX 기반 클라우드 게임을 쉽게 시도한 다음 더 많은 레벨을 올릴 수 있다는 것임
이번 GFN 목요일에는 클라우드에서 7개의 새로운 릴리스를 포함하여 10개의 게임을 제공하는 등 더 많은 게임이 준비되어 있음

NVIDIA.titleKo: 옴니버스 속으로 · 개발자가 프론티어 AI 에이전트를 사용하여 아이디어를 시뮬레이션으로 전환하는 방법
NVIDIA.summary:
Explore the projects below to see frontier AI models such as GPT-6 Astra at work, and check back for new examples from NVIDIA teams and developers across the ecosystem.
Johns built the application with a single prompt, then used a follow-up prompt to shift the scene to Earth’s daytime side so the planet was visible.
Developers are combining frontier AI models with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to help carry out that work — building applications for exploring scenarios, investigating failures and improving designs.

Apple.titleEn: Apple unveils the new Apple TV 4K, supercharged by Siri AI
Apple.titleKo: Apple, Siri AI로 강화된 새로운 Apple TV 4K 공개
Apple.summary:
Apple TV 4K (4th generation) is available for $299 (U.S.) or $49.83 (U.S.) per month for six months.
Expanded access to such features will be available for a fee in the future.

Google DeepMind.title: Alphabet President Ruth Porat on how Google is funding AI to win long term, and the biggest risks ahead | Fortune
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Alphabet President Ruth Porat on how Google is funding AI to win long term, and the biggest risks ahead | Fortune
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Alphabet 회장 Ruth Porat가 Google이 장기적으로 성공하기 위해 AI에 자금을 지원하는 방법과 향후 가장 큰 위험에 대해 설명 | 행운
Google DeepMind.summary:
Alphabet expects capital expenditures (capex) to “increase significantly” next year, Ruth Porat said Monday at Fortune ’s Most Powerful Women Summit in Santa Barbara, Calif., adding that the company remains “capacity constrained” as demand for compute grows.
Capital expenditures hit $44.9 billion in the second quarter, “with the vast majority of this spent in technical infrastructure to support our investments in AI,” Alphabet CFO Anat Ashkenazi said during the company’s Q2 earnings call.
Alphabet is spending roughly $200 billion this year to build out its AI capacity, and the company’s president and chief investment officer reiterated Google’s plan next year for the bill to be even more substantial.
summaryLinesEn: Alphabet expects capital expenditures (capex) to “increase significantly” next year, Ruth Porat said Monday at Fortune ’s Most Powerful Women Summit in Santa Barbara, Calif., adding that the company remains “capacity constrained” as demand for compute grows.

Capital expenditures hit $44.9 billion in the second quarter, “with the vast majority of this spent in technical infrastructure to support our investments in AI,” Alphabet CFO Anat Ashkenazi said during the company’s Q2 earnings call.

Alphabet is spending roughly $200 billion this year to build out its AI capacity, and the company’s president and chief investment officer reiterated Google’s plan next year for the bill to be even more substantial.
summaryLinesKo: 루스 포랏(Ruth Porat)은 월요일 캘리포니아주 산타바바라에서 열린 포춘지 선정 가장 영향력 있는 여성 서밋에서 알파벳은 내년에 자본 지출(capex)이 "크게 증가"할 것으로 예상하며, 컴퓨팅에 대한 수요가 증가함에 따라 회사는 여전히 "용량 제약"을 받고 있다고 덧붙였음
Alphabet CFO인 Anat Ashkenazi는 회사의 2분기 실적 발표에서 2분기에 자본 지출이 449억 달러에 이르렀으며 "이 중 대부분은 AI에 대한 투자를 지원하기 위한 기술 인프라에 지출되었습니다"라고 말함
알파벳은 AI 역량을 강화하기 위해 올해 약 2,000억 달러를 지출하고 있으며, 회사의 사장 겸 최고투자책임자(CIO)는 내년에 이 법안이 훨씬 더 커질 것이라는 구글의 계획을 반복함

Google DeepMind.title: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
Google DeepMind.titleKo: 전 Google 및 SpaceX 제품 관리자가 설립한 Satlyt는 위성에서 AI를 실행하기 위해 800만 달러를 모금함
Google DeepMind.summary:
So he left SpaceX and co-founded Satlyt , a new company with headquarters in Sunnyvale, California, and Nairobi, to build software for satellites that he hopes will let many satellites share the work of large computing jobs in space.
“It can just be driven by the number of satellites going up.”
SpaceX has since gone all-in on orbital data centers, and Satlyt’s software is set to launch Thursday on a SpaceX rocket alongside the first prototype for Google’s space data center effort, Project Suncatcher.

"그것은 올라가는 위성의 수에 따라 추진될 수 있음"
SpaceX는 이후 궤도 데이터 센터에 올인했으며 Satlyt의 소프트웨어는 Google의 우주 데이터 센터 노력의 첫 번째 프로토타입인 Project Suncatcher와 함께 목요일 SpaceX 로켓에서 출시될 예정임

Amazon.title: Mixture-of-Experts kernel engineering on Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleEn: Mixture-of-Experts kernel engineering on Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: Amazon SageMaker AI의 전문가 조합 커널 엔지니어링 | 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is a sparsely-activated architecture that scales large language model (LLM) capacity while keeping per-token compute low.
Consequently, the batch space or token row size is profoundly thin, regularly dropping to a profile where (M < 64), and frequently down to a single row (M = 1).
Because its operations account for a large share of total compute time, inefficiencies there directly raise request latency and cost.

결과적으로 배치 공간 또는 토큰 행 크기는 매우 얇아서 정기적으로 (M < 64) 프로필로 떨어지고 단일 행(M = 1)으로 떨어지는 경우가 많음

Building an AI agent for a demo and operating one for 40 million developers are different engineering problems.

Anthropic.title: Anthropic study warns that small AI models could soon replicate across everyday devices
Anthropic.titleEn: Anthropic study warns that small AI models could soon replicate across everyday devices
Anthropic.titleKo: 인류 연구는 작은 AI 모델이 곧 일상적인 장치에 복제될 수 있다고 경고함
Anthropic.summary:
Anthropic researchers tested whether small language models could spread on their own across poorly secured consumer devices like smart TVs or connected home appliances and set themselves up on unfamiliar hardware.
A model needs to be small enough to run on consumer devices and capable enough to replicate itself, and no model currently meets both requirements.
In tests using off-the-shelf $55 TV boxes, the GLM-5.2 model already completed the full replication chain across all eight test nodes.

Anthropic.title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system
Anthropic.titleEn: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system
Anthropic.summary:
After 21 hours spent searching this data by roughly 950 agents using 210 million tokens, one of the agents spotted something remarkable: a repeating pattern of DNA sequences that occurs next to the gene for an odd-looking RT.
Our research prior to joining Anthropic has helped to better understand the evolution and regulation of CRISPR systems, discover new enzymes for next-generation cell and gene therapies , and build tools for accelerating the identification of anomalies in DNA, such as human pathogenic variants.
We do research that involves only the lower levels of the biosafety risk level (BSL-1 and BSL-2) and we do not handle pathogens that can infect humans.

Anthropic에 합류하기 전 우리의 연구는 CRISPR 시스템의 진화와 규제를 더 잘 이해하고, 차세대 세포 및 유전자 치료를 위한 새로운 효소를 발견하고, 인간 병원성 변종과 같은 DNA의 변칙적 식별을 가속화하기 위한 도구를 구축하는 데 도움이 됨
우리는 낮은 수준의 생물안전 위험 수준(BSL-1 및 BSL-2)만을 포함하는 연구를 수행하며 인간을 감염시킬 수 있는 병원체는 취급하지 않음

Anthropic.title: AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter
Anthropic.titleEn: AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter
Anthropic.titleKo: AI 모델은 데이터 센터에 액세스하지 않고도 자체 복제가 가능함
Anthropic.summary:
Small models, such as Qwen3.5-9B, are capable of setting up inference servers on hardware from Jetson Nanos to Mac PCs and RTX 4090s.
Larger models tend to have correspondingly better cyber capabilities, but will also need to breach (relatively) hardened datacenters to run themselves.
We run Gemma4-26B-A4B, distributed over 15 inexpensive off-brand Android TV boxes (~$55 each) that we bought and networked together, at 0.39 tokens per second.

Anthropic.title: Investigating unintended model actions in our evaluations and internal use
Anthropic.titleEn: Investigating unintended model actions in our evaluations and internal use
Anthropic.titleKo: 평가 및 내부 사용에서 의도하지 않은 모델 동작 조사
Anthropic.summary:
In another evaluation, Claude Haiku 4.5 was instructed to complete a form up until the final submission stage, but to stop before actually submitting.
Some of the public evaluations we no longer run; others we have moved to their offline versions, or rebuilt them so that their tasks do not reach live websites.
Although the impact of these behaviors was minimal and we had already turned off live internet access for some high-risk and cybersecurity evaluations, we have now decided to expand that to include all our internal evaluations until we have confirmed that our security and monitoring measures (described in the remediation section of this post) reliably catch behaviors like these.

Anthropic.title: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
Anthropic.titleEn: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
Anthropic.summary:
Early evidence suggests that these methods have reduced the amount of data harvested by distillers by around 90 to 99 percent.
In response to the increasing sophistication and scale of these attacks, we’ve expanded and greatly strengthened our defenses against them.
We expect that distillation will remain a cat-and-mouse game, and that we’ll need to continue iterating on our defenses over time.

Anthropic.title: Introducing Claude Corps
Anthropic.summary:
Over the next 12 months, at least 400 nonprofits will host Claude Corps Fellows.
A nonpartisan think-and-do tank focused on accelerating economic growth in the American heartland.
Fellows will receive a full-time salary of $85,000 and benefits, support from a CodePath mentor, office hours from Anthropic for their technical questions, an expansive Claude token budget, and professional guidance from their manager at the host organization.

Anthropic.title: An opt-in vulnerability-finding service for open-source software
Anthropic.titleEn: An opt-in vulnerability-finding service for open-source software
Anthropic.titleKo: 오픈 소스 소프트웨어에 대한 선택적인 취약점 찾기 서비스
Anthropic.summary:
We’re launching OSS Scanner , an opt-in vulnerability scanner for the open-source ecosystem informed by our experience using Claude to find vulnerabilities during Project Glasswing .
Each report contains a self-contained reproducer, explanation of the vulnerability (including a bisection to determine when the bug was introduced, where possible), and candidate patch (when available) for how the bug can be fixed.
Inspired by the positive impact on the open source ecosystem of Google's OSS-Fuzz , a project that scans open-source software for vulnerabilities with fuzzers, we are launching OSS Scanner to find vulnerabilities in open-source code with our strongest language models.

Anthropic.title: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission
Anthropic.summary:
Building on our commitment to American scientific discovery Anthropic is committing $150 million over three years to the Genesis Mission, a federal initiative to accelerate scientific and technological discovery through AI.
Earlier this week, we merged Project Glasswing into our expanded Cyber Verification Program , which gives many more defenders access to our most capable models.
As part of Project Glasswing , partners uncovered many vulnerabilities, but we haven’t yet achieved a sufficient reduction in cyber risk.

OpenAI.summary:
Global cross-Region inference routes requests across supported commercial AWS Regions where the model is deployed, giving you broad access to Amazon Bedrock capacity.
Teams in Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, and Taiwan need access to the newest OpenAI models beyond that capacity.
To call any of these models through a global cross-Region inference profile, your IAM policy needs four statements: Access to the inference profile and the project/default resource in your source Region.

OpenAI.titleEn: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sink on OpenAI revenue report
OpenAI.titleKo: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave 및 기타 AI 주식은 OpenAI 수익 보고서에서 하락
OpenAI.summary:
OpenAI told investors that it hit roughly $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September, CNBC confirmed, lower than the the $68 billion figure widely reported late last month.
A person familiar with the matter said the $68 billion figure included gross revenue from OpenAI's partners, which helps investors make a more direct comparison with Anthropic.
Nvidia shares fell 3%, Oracle shares fell nearly 6% and CoreWeave shares slipped nearly 8% on Thursday.

OpenAI.title: How NVIDIA GPUs Help Accelerate OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast
OpenAI.titleEn: How NVIDIA GPUs Help Accelerate OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast
OpenAI.titleKo: NVIDIA GPU가 OpenAI의 GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast를 가속화하는 데 어떻게 도움이 됩니까
OpenAI.summary:
“NVIDIA’s deep investment in tooling and documentation has enabled us to make our models exceptionally good at programming Blackwell and Rubin GPUs,” said Philippe Tillet, inference lead at OpenAI.
Accelerated by inference optimizations through OpenAI’s models that tap into the capabilities of the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, Ultrafast offers up to 8x faster token generation than the Astra Standard mode.
OpenAI is using its own models to help refine the inference software running on NVIDIA GPUs, taking advantage of the platform’s programmability to test and implement improvements.

OpenAI.title: OpenAI is sued over rogue AI Hugging Face cyberattack
OpenAI.titleEn: OpenAI is sued over rogue AI Hugging Face cyberattack
OpenAI.titleKo: OpenAI, 악성 AI Hugging Face 사이버 공격으로 고소당함
OpenAI.summary:
Nvidia announced it had agreed to pay roughly $13 billion to buy Hugging Face earlier this month.
CEO Clément Delangue previously said in July he asked OpenAI to commit $100 million in compute "to help the Hugging Face community build powerful cyber defenses with the best open and closed models."
OpenAI had tried to invest $100 million into the startup after the cyberattack, though talks fell apart in the early stages, sources told CNBC.

SpaceX.title: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
SpaceX.titleEn: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
SpaceX.titleKo: 전 Google 및 SpaceX 제품 관리자가 설립한 Satlyt는 위성에서 AI를 실행하기 위해 800만 달러를 모금함
SpaceX.summary:
So he left SpaceX and co-founded Satlyt , a new company with headquarters in Sunnyvale, California, and Nairobi, to build software for satellites that he hopes will let many satellites share the work of large computing jobs in space.
“It can just be driven by the number of satellites going up.”
SpaceX has since gone all-in on orbital data centers, and Satlyt’s software is set to launch Thursday on a SpaceX rocket alongside the first prototype for Google’s space data center effort, Project Suncatcher.

"그것은 올라가는 위성의 수에 따라 추진될 수 있음"
SpaceX는 이후 궤도 데이터 센터에 올인했으며 Satlyt의 소프트웨어는 Google의 우주 데이터 센터 노력의 첫 번째 프로토타입인 Project Suncatcher와 함께 목요일 SpaceX 로켓에서 출시될 예정임

SpaceX.summary:
For production use, we recommend generating a short-term bearer token from your existing AWS credentials, so authentication stays tied to your IAM identity and no long-lived secret is stored: Reasoning tokens count as output tokens and draw down max_completion_tokens before the answer text is produced, so size the limit to leave room for both.
Your AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) identity needs bedrock:InvokeModel on both the inference profile and your account’s default project: arn:aws:bedrock:{region}::inference-profile/us.xai.grok-4.7 or the global. equivalent. arn:aws:bedrock:{region}:{account-id}:project/default .
In this post, we build a tool-calling agent on Grok 4.7 and evaluate it on three tasks that require search rather than lookup.

summaryLinesKo: 프로덕션 용도의 경우 기존 AWS 자격 증명에서 단기 전달자 토큰을 생성하는 것이 좋음 · 그러면 인증이 IAM 자격 증명에 계속 연결되고 장기 비밀이 저장되지 않음 · 추론 토큰은 출력 토큰으로 계산되고 답변 텍스트가 생성되기 전에 max_completion_tokens를 가져오므로 두 가지 모두를 위한 여유 공간을 확보할 수 있도록 제한 크기를 조정하세요

AWS Identity and Access Management(IAM) ID에는 추론 프로필과 계정의 기본 프로젝트(arn:aws:bedrock:{region}::inference-profile/us.xai.grok-4.7 또는 전역) 모두에서 bedrock:InvokeModel이 필요함 · 동등한 · arn:aws:bedrock:{지역}:{account-id}:project/default
이 게시물에서는 Grok 4.7에서 도구 호출 에이전트를 구축하고 조회가 아닌 검색이 필요한 세 가지 작업에서 이를 평가함

SpaceX.title: SpaceX launches Google AI chips into orbit in push toward space-based data centers
SpaceX.titleEn: SpaceX launches Google AI chips into orbit in push toward space-based data centers
SpaceX.titleKo: SpaceX, 우주 기반 데이터 센터를 향한 추진으로 Google AI 칩을 궤도에 진입
SpaceX.summary:
The Transporter-18 mission marks the first in-orbit test for Alphabet's Project Suncatcher, ​a "moonshot" initiative to develop reliable AI computing infrastructure in space.
Alphabet launched its homegrown AI chips into orbit on Thursday in a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, a step towards making data centers in space a reality.
Industry experts say space-based data centers represent a far-out mission, if they can even become feasible, in part because rocket launches remain capacity-constrained and expensive.

Databricks.titleEn: How Flo Health built safer, more useful open models with Databricks AI Runtime | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: Flo Health가 Databricks AI Runtime을 사용하여 더욱 안전하고 유용한 개방형 모델을 구축한 방법 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
Flo ran distributed fine-tuning on 32 NVIDIA H100 GPUs with Databricks AI Runtime, improving medical safety from 34% to approximately 61%, usefulness from 42% to 76%, and the combined score from 16% to 47%.
As Flo moved from using only traditional ML towards personalized insights powered by generative AI, the team saw the potential for a more flexible, personalized product.
Because Flo’s products deal with health and well-being, responses need to be medically safe and genuinely useful.

Databricks.summary:
Governed data sharing lets every tier of the supply chain publish validated evidence from existing records without exposing source systems.
More than a dozen executive orders and directives since 2020, culminating in the August 2026 Supplier Cost and Pricing Transparency memorandum , now mandate actual cost data, critical supply chain mapping at every tier, and continuous performance visibility across a base of more than 200,000 suppliers.
The DoW needs cost and supply chain visibility across 200,000+ suppliers, but manual data calls and fragmented spreadsheets hinder insight.

2020년 이후 12개 이상의 행정 명령 및 지침이 2026년 8월 공급업체 비용 및 가격 투명성 각서로 정점을 이루었으며 이제 실제 비용 데이터, 모든 계층의 중요한 공급망 매핑, 200,000개 이상의 공급업체 기반에 대한 지속적인 성과 가시성을 요구함

Databricks.title: From post-training to production: How TinyFish runs its web-native model on Databricks AI Runtime | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: From post-training to production: How TinyFish runs its web-native model on Databricks AI Runtime | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: 사후 교육부터 프로덕션까지 · TinyFish가 Databricks AI Runtime에서 웹 기반 모델을 실행하는 방법 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
In TinyFish's internal go/no-go benchmark, its web-native model achieved a 77.6% task-success rate across 2,178 web-agent tasks, measuring whether the full agent successfully completed the requested work.
As the company expanded its model work, the team also had to build the infrastructure around it: GPU compute for post-training, evaluation that could measure the behavior of the full agent, production serving, and the data needed to understand how the system was performing.
AI Runtime provides managed GPU infrastructure for training and fine-tuning, while MLflow supports evaluation and Databricks Model Serving provides the production serving layer.

As the company expanded its model work, the team also had to build the infrastructure around it: GPU compute for post-training, evaluation that could measure the behavior of the full agent, production serving, and the data needed to understand how the system was performing.
AI Runtime provides managed GPU infrastructure for training and fine-tuning, while MLflow supports evaluation and Databricks Model Serving provides the production serving layer.
summaryLinesKo: TinyFish의 내부 go/no-go 벤치마크에서 웹 네이티브 모델은 2,178개의 웹 에이전트 작업에서 77.6%의 작업 성공률을 달성하여 전체 에이전트가 요청된 작업을 성공적으로 완료했는지 여부를 측정함
회사가 모델 작업을 확장함에 따라 팀은 훈련 후를 위한 GPU 컴퓨팅, 전체 에이전트의 동작을 측정할 수 있는 평가, 프로덕션 서비스, 시스템 성능을 이해하는 데 필요한 데이터 등 주변 인프라도 구축해야 함
AI Runtime은 학습 및 미세 조정을 위한 관리형 GPU 인프라를 제공하고, MLflow는 평가를 지원하고 Databricks Model Serving은 프로덕션 서비스 계층을 제공함

Databricks.title: How California built its Behavioral Health Public County Profile on Databricks | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: How California built its Behavioral Health Public County Profile on Databricks | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: 캘리포니아가 Databricks에서 행동 건강 공공 카운티 프로필을 구축한 방법 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
The California Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) built the Behavioral Health Public County Profile on the Databricks platform, a first-of-its-kind public dashboard that brings behavioral health data from all 58 counties into one place for nearly 40 million Californians.
Built to support the Behavioral Health Services Act (BHSA) following Proposition 1, the dashboard resolves data fragmentation across all 58 counties, enabling transparent tracking of local funding, service delivery, and homelessness initiatives.
On October 1, 2026, Governor Gavin Newsom announced the launch of the County Profile, calling it a tool that empowers people to see how their counties plan, fund, and deliver behavioral health services and to hold government accountable for results.
summaryLinesEn: The California Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) built the Behavioral Health Public County Profile on the Databricks platform, a first-of-its-kind public dashboard that brings behavioral health data from all 58 counties into one place for nearly 40 million Californians.

Built to support the Behavioral Health Services Act (BHSA) following Proposition 1, the dashboard resolves data fragmentation across all 58 counties, enabling transparent tracking of local funding, service delivery, and homelessness initiatives.

On October 1, 2026, Governor Gavin Newsom announced the launch of the County Profile, calling it a tool that empowers people to see how their counties plan, fund, and deliver behavioral health services and to hold government accountable for results.
summaryLinesKo: 캘리포니아 보건 서비스부(DHCS)는 거의 4천만 명의 캘리포니아 주민들을 위해 58개 카운티 전체의 행동 건강 데이터를 한 곳으로 가져오는 최초의 공개 대시보드인 Databricks 플랫폼에 행동 건강 공공 카운티 프로필을 구축함
발의안 1에 따라 행동 건강 서비스법(BHSA)을 지원하기 위해 구축된 대시보드는 58개 카운티 전체의 데이터 단편화를 해결하여 지역 자금 조달, 서비스 제공 및 노숙자 이니셔티브를 투명하게 추적할 수 있음
2026년 10월 1일, Gavin Newsom 주지사는 카운티 프로필의 출시를 발표하여 사람들이 카운티에서 행동 건강 서비스를 계획, 자금 조달 및 제공하는 방법을 확인하고 정부가 결과에 대해 책임을 지도록 하는 도구라고 말함

Databricks.title: Biomedical Imaging's Real Bottleneck Is the Data, Not the Model | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: Biomedical Imaging's Real Bottleneck Is the Data, Not the Model | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: 생체의학 이미징의 실제 병목 현상은 모델이 아니라 데이터입니다 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
A well-known BMJ review (Nagendran et al., 2020) of deep-learning-versus-clinician imaging studies found that of 81 studies, only a handful were prospective or tested in a real clinical setting, and code and data were unavailable in 93% and 95% of them.
Curating multi-site training data that represents the real world, then proving it to regulators through the 510(k) and PMA pathways, is both the moat and the cost.
That reproducibility debt traces straight back to how hard imaging data is to share and re-run.

실제 세계를 대표하는 다중 현장 교육 데이터를 선별한 다음 510(k) 및 PMA 경로를 통해 규제 기관에 이를 입증하는 것은 해자이자 비용임

It uses copy-on-write, so branches share the parent branch data but only consume additional storage as they diverge.
As coding agents take on a growing share of development work, developers are increasingly shifting toward orchestrating them.
Agents move faster, operate in parallel and need a safe environment to avoid putting production data at risk or exposing sensitive data.

Databricks.titleEn: Introducing Funke: Native HL7v2 Parsing on Databricks | Databricks Blog

Databricks.summary:
Funke is open source and ships with a runnable demo, so you can stand up an end-to-end HL7 ingestion pipeline and explore parsed clinical data in minutes.
Decades after it was introduced, it remains the most widely deployed integration standard in the industry, and the vast majority of care organizations still depend on it for the routine flow of operational data.
Or they hand the messages to a third-party engine that flattens the hierarchy into wide tables, which means paying another vendor, moving data out of the platform, and losing direct access to the granular structure underneath.

sourceLines: Funke is open source and ships with a runnable demo, so you can stand up an end-to-end HL7 ingestion pipeline and explore parsed clinical data in minutes.

Or they hand the messages to a third-party engine that flattens the hierarchy into wide tables, which means paying another vendor, moving data out of the platform, and losing direct access to the granular structure underneath.

Databricks.summary:
Unlock workforce and financial insights with Genie: Use the new Workday Data Connect connector (Beta) to query current people and financial data in place, combine it with customer, market, and operational data already in Databricks, and enable Genie-powered natural-language exploration, real-time financial planning, workforce analytics, and AI on trusted, governed data.
We're excited to announce the publicly available Beta of the Workday Data Connect federation connector for Unity Catalog, built for data platform and analytics teams that need Workday HR and finance data alongside the rest of their enterprise data in Databricks.
The release builds on our partnership announced at Workday Rising 2025 , where Databricks was named a Workday Data Cloud launch partner.

Mistral AI.titleEn: Mistral unveils new AI model it says rivals best open systems from China
Mistral AI.titleKo: 미스트랄, 새로운 AI 모델 공개…중국 최고의 개방형 시스템과 경쟁
Mistral AI.summary:
Long considered Europe's only answer to OpenAI and Anthropic, Mistral raised a 3 billion euros ($3.4 billion) Series D in September at a 21 billion euro valuation.
Nvidia-backed American startup Reflection AI unveiled its first open model on Monday, which it claimed matched the capability of GLM 5.2, which was surpassed by GLM 5.3 in August.
The company added that ML4 was the strongest open-weight model developed outside China by a "substantial margin."
summaryLinesEn: Long considered Europe's only answer to OpenAI and Anthropic, Mistral raised a 3 billion euros ($3.4 billion) Series D in September at a 21 billion euro valuation.
Nvidia-backed American startup Reflection AI unveiled its first open model on Monday, which it claimed matched the capability of GLM 5.2, which was surpassed by GLM 5.3 in August.
The company added that ML4 was the strongest open-weight model developed outside China by a "substantial margin."
summaryLinesKo: 오랫동안 OpenAI와 Anthropic에 대한 유럽의 유일한 해답으로 여겨졌던 Mistral은 지난 9월에 210억 유로의 평가액으로 30억 유로(34억 달러)의 시리즈 D를 유치함
Nvidia가 지원하는 미국 스타트업 Reflection AI는 월요일 첫 번째 공개 모델을 공개했는데, 이는 8월 GLM 5.3을 능가한 GLM 5.2의 기능과 일치한다고 주장함
회사는 ML4가 중국 이외 지역에서 개발된 가장 강력한 개방형 중량 모델이라고 덧붙였음

Replies can stream as they’re written, and companies can hold a request open until there’s news to share.

Sierra AI.title: Introducing Personal Agent Protocol
Sierra AI.summary:
Personal Agent Protocol gives them that foundation — so the company and the personal agent can get the job done for the customer they share.
When a task requires access to a customer’s account, they can sign in on the company’s page or use credentials they have already set up with their personal agent.
Everyone wants security, but they have different needs, too: Consumers want speed, dependability, and trust — for the job to be done right the first time, by a personal agent they can count on to act in their best interests.

Sierra AI.summary:
But Ghostwriter isn’t DMing you on Slack when it thinks your AI agent’s sales promotion’s lost its effectiveness.
With Sierra’s Ghostwriter , our customers have transitioned from code to clicks to prompts , dramatically speeding up how they build and deploy agents.
It reviews recent calls, identifies three specific changes, shows the conversations behind each one, estimates how many customers each change could help, and recommends which two to tackle first.

Suno.title: Introducing Speech (beta)
Suno.summary:
Speech opens up another canvas for that same kind of creativity.
Every day, people make songs for birthdays, weddings, inside jokes, faith and worship, their kids, their friends, and moments that might mean absolutely nothing to anyone else but mean everything to them.
Today, we’re expanding what's possible in Suno with Speech : the first audio model that generates voice and music together as one cohesive track.

Suno.title: Three Must-learn Tips for Using EQ
Suno.titleEn: Three Must-learn Tips for Using EQ
Suno.titleKo: EQ 사용을 위해 꼭 배워야 할 3가지 팁
Suno.summary:
You first instinct might be to turn up the high-mids and treble for a bit more presence.
Suno Studio has had EQ per track since it launched in 2025.
Digital audio has a theoretical maximum (0dBFS) meaning everything you add, including gain from your various EQ bands, will need to find a space in your master bus: the combination of all your tracks and effects.

Hugging Face.title: Impactful scheduling for GPU clusters
Hugging Face.titleKo: GPU 클러스터에 대한 영향력 있는 스케줄링
Hugging Face.summary:
The workload is scheduled according to the fair-share algorithm, weighted by a ratio of actual occupancy to allocated time in the lookback window.
As a result, we shifted the debate about how much GPU time each research project deserves from a case-by-case operational task to a transparent administrative budgeting process.
Overcommitting Tragedy of the commons Budgets not schedules Fair-share The scheduling contract Simulations Results Challenges The future Building a cluster scheduler to prioritize high-impact research while maintaining full occupancy On the AI Infrastructure team at Ai2, we’re responsible for providing the institute’s GPU compute capacity, specifically targeting large, distributed training workloads.

Hugging Face.title: The model that didn't exist, so you made it yourself
Hugging Face.titleEn: The model that didn't exist, so you made it yourself
Hugging Face.summary:
The compute for the whole project, including having the 9B model label 8,797 example requests, came to USD 16.
By my 6th project it was closer to 2,000, because each project taught me something I wanted in the next one.
Logolabs' Agate Preview 002 is a 260M-parameter text-to-image model, small enough for a browser, but it needs 50 steps with guidance, which is 100 network passes per image.

Hugging Face.title: One Model Family, Two Gold-Level Results: Fine-Tuning Nemotron for IOI and IMO
Hugging Face.titleEn: One Model Family, Two Gold-Level Results: Fine-Tuning Nemotron for IOI and IMO
Hugging Face.titleKo: 하나의 모델 제품군, 두 개의 골드 레벨 결과 · IOI 및 IMO를 위한 Nemotron 미세 조정
Hugging Face.summary:
Starting from Nemotron 3, our teams used supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and feedback-driven inference to create systems that reached gold-medal level at both IMO 2026 and IOI 2026 .
That finding guided the competition-specific Ultra-CC system used for IOI 2026, which scored 535.4 out of 600.
With GenCorrect, our iterative generate-evaluate-refine strategy, it reached 468 points and crossed the gold threshold of 438.3.

With GenCorrect, our iterative generate-evaluate-refine strategy, it reached 468 points and crossed the gold threshold of 438.3.
summaryLinesKo: Nemotron 3부터 우리 팀은 감독된 미세 조정(SFT), 강화 학습(RL) 및 피드백 기반 추론을 사용하여 IMO 2026 및 IOI 2026에서 모두 금메달 수준에 도달한 시스템을 만들었음
이러한 결과는 600점 만점에 535.4점을 획득한 IOI 2026에 사용된 대회별 Ultra-CC 시스템의 지침이 됨
반복적인 생성-평가-정제 전략인 GenCordirect를 사용하면 468포인트에 도달하고 438.3의 골드 임계값을 넘었음

Hugging Face.title: Introducing Falcon ASR
Hugging Face.summary:
In our evaluation, Falcon-ASR achieved an average word error rate of 20.92% across six Arabic test sets, compared with the best published result of 23.17% in the leaderboard snapshot we used.
In our evaluation on the seven public English test sets used by the Hugging Face Open ASR Leaderboard, it achieved a mean WER of 5.74%.
In our internal Emirati evaluation, Falcon-ASR achieved 22.73% WER and 10.19% CER: Falcon-ASR has the lowest WER and CER among the systems compared here.

Hugging Face.title: Multimodal open d1 decision models for the edge
Hugging Face.titleEn: Multimodal open d1 decision models for the edge
Hugging Face.titleKo: 에지에 대한 다중 모드 개방형 d1 결정 모델
Hugging Face.summary:
Multimodal: d1-3B supports text and images, while d1-omni-600M supports text and images or text and audio Fast: d1-3B answers a question in 16 ms on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor, 26 ms on a Jetson AGX Orin, and 50ms on a Jetson Orin Nano These open d1 decision models are built on our Liquid Foundation Models (LFMs).
Reach for d1 decision models when you need fast, structured decisions, including multimodal inputs. d1-3B delivers the highest decision quality at its size, while d1-omni-600M fits where footprint matters.
Unlike our generative models, decision models don’t produce tokens but answer in a single forward pass. d1-3B and d1-omni-600M are trained from two very different backbones: d1-3B is trained from LFM2.5-VL-3B , our latest VLM, which is decoder-only.

Hugging Face.title: Open TTS Leaderboard: Scalable Evaluation for Multilingual Text-to-Speech and Voice Cloning
Hugging Face.titleEn: Open TTS Leaderboard: Scalable Evaluation for Multilingual Text-to-Speech and Voice Cloning
Hugging Face.titleKo: 공개 TTS 리더보드 · 다국어 텍스트 음성 변환 및 음성 복제를 위한 확장 가능한 평가
Hugging Face.summary:
The goal of the Open TTS Leaderboard is not only to keep up with the incredible pace of TTS model releases, but to be shaped by the community; we want to hear your feedback so the evaluations stay relevant and insightful.
By toggling “Voice cloning”, the models that support this functionality (on the selected languages) can be compared.
This may partly explain why open-source models are underrepresented on arena-style leaderboards: as of Sep 30, 2026, only 16 of the 92 models on Artificial Analysis are open-weights, with a similar skew on Voice Arena .

This may partly explain why open-source models are underrepresented on arena-style leaderboards: as of Sep 30, 2026, only 16 of the 92 models on Artificial Analysis are open-weights, with a similar skew on Voice Arena .

"음성 복제"를 전환하면 이 기능을 지원하는 모델(선택한 언어에서)을 비교할 수 있음

Another innovation from TCL CSOT is the adoption of organic light-emitting diode (OLED) technology for inkjet printing (IJP).
Source: TCL CSOT TCL CSOT also introduced the World’s First Foldable & Portable IJP OLED Monitor Display (28″) at SID Display Week 2026.

Abridge.title: How Corewell clinician uses Abridge Assistant in her practice
Abridge.titleEn: How Corewell clinician uses Abridge Assistant in her practice
Abridge.titleKo: Corewell 임상의가 진료에 Abridge Assistant를 사용하는 방법
Abridge.summary:
Built by clinicians and machine learning scientists working side by side, it's trained to weigh what matters the way a clinician would: the allergy that rules out a drug, the family history that moves a screening up, the guideline exception this patient meets.
As a practicing primary care clinician, she's using Abridge Assistant's context-aware decision support across her own workflow.
In our conversation, she shared how Abridge Assistant has transformed her practice before, during, and after visits, and where she sees Abridge having the greatest impact.

Writer.title: WRITER connectors: Governed agent access across enterprise systems
Writer.titleEn: WRITER connectors: Governed agent access across enterprise systems
Writer.titleKo: WRITER 커넥터 · 엔터프라이즈 시스템 전반에 걸쳐 관리되는 에이전트 액세스
Writer.summary:
WRITER Agent retrieves campaign performance from HubSpot, analyzes engagement trends, synthesizes insights in a presentation with visualized charts and graphs, uses the latest product information sitting in docs on platforms like Confluence or SharePoint to write new campaign emails, then assigns follow-up tasks and notifies relevant teams in project management and communication tools like Asana and Microsoft Teams.
Here are three examples of real-world workflows that illustrate this shift: WRITER Agent draws performance and holdings data from Snowflake or Databricks, enriches it with public and private market signals from FactSet and PitchBook, and produces heatmaps and risk alerts saved back into SharePoint.
On the platform side, WRITER gives admins centralized control surfaces to manage connectors, define allowed operations, manage OAuth at the org or user level, and review usage through session logs.

Here are three examples of real-world workflows that illustrate this shift: WRITER Agent draws performance and holdings data from Snowflake or Databricks, enriches it with public and private market signals from FactSet and PitchBook, and produces heatmaps and risk alerts saved back into SharePoint.
On the platform side, WRITER gives admins centralized control surfaces to manage connectors, define allowed operations, manage OAuth at the org or user level, and review usage through session logs.

Writer.titleKo: WRITER 에이전트 소개 · 엔터프라이즈 규모를 위한 새로운 에이전트 설계 패턴
Writer.summary:
From board materials and sales decks to research summaries and strategy presentations, WRITER Agent handles the heavy lifting – structuring the narrative, integrating your enterprise context, producing charts and visuals, and infusing your brand – so that teams can go from idea to presentation-ready in minutes.
But reaching that level from the current baseline will require an order-of-magnitude increase in AI usage, and that kind of adoption won’t happen without a fundamental shift in how enterprises use AI.
With personality profiles , WRITER Agent allows you to create and select voice profiles that carry through every type of output generated – from research briefs and competitive analyses to sales collateral, customer communications, and all forms of content – ensuring every output sounds like you , not a generic AI.

But reaching that level from the current baseline will require an order-of-magnitude increase in AI usage, and that kind of adoption won’t happen without a fundamental shift in how enterprises use AI.

With personality profiles , WRITER Agent allows you to create and select voice profiles that carry through every type of output generated – from research briefs and competitive analyses to sales collateral, customer communications, and all forms of content – ensuring every output sounds like you , not a generic AI.
summaryLinesKo: 보드 자료 및 판매 자료부터 연구 요약 및 전략 프리젠테이션에 이르기까지 WRITER Agent는 내러티브 구조화, 기업 컨텍스트 통합, 차트 및 시각 자료 생성, 브랜드 주입 등의 힘든 작업을 처리하므로 팀은 몇 분 만에 아이디어에서 프레젠테이션 준비를 완료할 수 있음
그러나 현재 기준에서 해당 수준에 도달하려면 AI 사용량이 대폭 증가해야 하며, 기업이 AI를 사용하는 방식을 근본적으로 바꾸지 않으면 이러한 채택이 이루어지지 않을 것임
성격 프로필을 사용하면 WRITER 에이전트를 사용하면 연구 요약 및 경쟁 분석부터 판매 보조 자료, 고객 커뮤니케이션 및 모든 형태의 콘텐츠에 이르기까지 생성된 모든 유형의 출력을 전달하는 음성 프로필을 생성하고 선택할 수 있으므로 모든 출력이 일반 AI가 아닌 귀하와 같은 소리를 내도록 보장함

We introduce 4Director, a video world model conditioned on an explicit 4D scene representation: each object is reconstructed once from the input image as a canonical mesh and moved by one prescribed rigid transformation per frame.
Arbor: Explicit Geometric Conditioning for Controllable 3D Asset Generation SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
For training, we construct RealCOD-Rigid, a new dataset of 20,774 clips annotated with rigid 3D scenes by our automatic pipeline.

Meta AI.summary:
According to Artificial Analysis, Muse Wonder runs $4.52 per task on the Intelligence Index, nearly three times more than Muse Spark 1.3 ($1.60).

Meta AI.title: China's Manus raises over $500M in first funding round since split with Meta
Meta AI.titleEn: China's Manus raises over $500M in first funding round since split with Meta
Meta AI.titleKo: 중국의 Manus는 Meta와의 분할 이후 첫 번째 자금 조달 라운드에서 5억 달러 이상을 모금함
Meta AI.summary:
Chinese AI lab Manus’ parent company, Butterfly Effect, said on Thursday in a WeChat post that it has raised more than $500 million, the company’s first funding round since Meta was forced to call off its $2 billion acquisition of the startup.
The company recently launched Manus 2.0 , which it says brings a new architecture with new products and capabilities built around a new harness.
The startup was said to be pulling in annual recurring revenue of over $100 million at the time.

Kling AI.titleEn: Kuaishou’s Kling AI targets Hong Kong IPO, may raise at least $1 bln - Bloomberg
Kling AI.titleKo: Kuaishou의 Kling AI, 홍콩 IPO 목표로 최소 10억 달러 조달 가능 - Bloomberg
Kling AI.summary:
Investing.com-- Kuaishou Technology's (HK:1024) Kling AI video platform has selected banks for a Hong Kong initial public offering that could raise at least $1 billion, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Kling, launched in 2024, raised $2.8 billion in July from investors including Alibaba Group, Tencent Holdings and Baidu, valuing the company at about $15 billion before the funding, according to Bloomberg.
Hong Kong-listed Kuaishou shares rose 3% to HK$30.38 by 03:57 GMT on Tuesday.
summaryLinesEn: Investing.com-- Kuaishou Technology's (HK:1024) Kling AI video platform has selected banks for a Hong Kong initial public offering that could raise at least $1 billion, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.

Kling, launched in 2024, raised $2.8 billion in July from investors including Alibaba Group, Tencent Holdings and Baidu, valuing the company at about $15 billion before the funding, according to Bloomberg.
Hong Kong-listed Kuaishou shares rose 3% to HK$30.38 by 03:57 GMT on Tuesday.
summaryLinesKo: Investing.com-- Kuaishou Technology(HK:1024)의 Kling AI 비디오 플랫폼이 최소 10억 달러를 조달할 수 있는 홍콩 기업공개(IPO)를 위해 은행을 선정했다고 Bloomberg News가 이 문제에 정통한 소식통을 인용하여 화요일 보도함
블룸버그에 따르면 2024년 출범한 클링은 지난 7월 알리바바 그룹, 텐센트 홀딩스, 바이두 등 투자자들로부터 28억 달러를 조달해 자금 조달 전 회사 가치를 약 150억 달러로 평가함
홍콩 상장 Kuaishou 주가는 화요일 03:57 GMT까지 3% 상승한 HK$30.38을 기록함
